notes.subject: השטף / ישטפו
notes.rationale: Kokɔrɔ-yɛlɛma: deluge/flood (שטף) and to-be-swept-away (ישטפו) — a single Hebrew root repeated for picture and effect; Bambara cannot keep it with one root.

notes.subject: layidu-nana-tigi
notes.rationale: נגיד ברית (prince of the covenant): translators dispute the referent — the high priest Onias III, or any allied leader; the Hebrew leaves it unnamed, so the rendering stays bare.

notes.subject: bolow
notes.rationale: זרעות is literally 'arms' (force/strength as outstretched arm); 'fasan bolow' keeps the body-picture rather than abstract 'forces'.

translation: Fasan bolow bɛna bɔ a ɲɛfɛ, ka tiɲɛnɛ; ani layidu-nana-tigi fana.
